nonrec theorem integral_neg : ∫ x in a..b, -f x ∂μ = -∫ x in a..b, f x ∂μ := by
  simp only [intervalIntegral, integral_neg]; abel

@[simp]
theorem integral_sub (hf : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) (hg : IntervalIntegrable g μ a b) :
    ∫ x in a..b, f x - g x ∂μ = (∫ x in a..b, f x ∂μ) - ∫ x in a..b, g x ∂μ := by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using! (integral_add hf hg.neg).trans (congr_arg _ integral_neg)

variable [∀ i, Div (G i)]

@[to_additive]
instance instDiv : Div (∀ i, G i) where div f g i := f i / g i

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma div_apply (f g : ∀ i, G i) (i : ι) : (f / g) i = f i / g i := rfl

variable [∀ i, Pow (M i) α]

@[to_additive (attr := to_additive) instSMul]
instance instPow : Pow (∀ i, M i) α where pow f a i := f i ^ a

@[to_additive (attr := simp, to_additive) (reorder := 5 6) smul_apply]
lemma pow_apply (f : ∀ i, M i) (a : α) (i : ι) : (f ^ a) i = f i ^ a := rfl

rw [heq] at h
  exact h

/-- Literal original grid geometry and its original local curvature. -/
def cellLeft (i : ℕ) : ℝ := (i : ℝ)/16384
def cellRight (i : ℕ) : ℝ := ((i : ℝ)+1)/16384
def cellCurvature (i : ℕ) : ℝ := 1/(cellLeft i-1)
